title: Customization
subtitle: Your brand on the screens your respondents see.
websiteHint: Don't worry — we'll fetch the styles from your website automatically, and you can adjust them afterwards.
websiteChanged: When you save, we'll read this website and design your styles from it. The logo, font and color below won't be sent this time.
websiteRemoved: When you save, the website is removed and your current logo, font and color are kept.
logoHint: A PNG, SVG or JPG image published on the web.
brandColorHint: Used for buttons, links and the focused field. Format #RRGGBB.

errors.website: Enter a website address that starts with http:// or https://.
errors.logoUrl: Enter an image address that starts with http:// or https://.
errors.brandColor: Enter a color as # followed by 6 hexadecimal digits, e.g. #8249DF.
